intro.label: Careers
intro.body: A small team building high-speed UAV systems.

roles.title: CAD Engineer
roles.summary: Create and maintain technical CAD drawings in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or CATIA. Rapid design iteration as changes come in.
do: Create and maintain technical CAD drawings of the airframe and related parts.
Work in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or CATIA.
Iterate the design quickly as geometry, manufacturing, or test feedback changes.
Keep models and drawings current for manufacturing.
lookingFor: Working experience in SolidWorks, Fusion 360, or CATIA.
Experience producing and maintaining technical CAD drawings.
Available to work on-site in India.

roles.title: CFD Simulation Engineer
roles.summary: CFD and FEA simulations in Ansys for the airframe.
do: Use results to support design and manufacturing decisions.
lookingFor: Working experience with CFD and FEA in Ansys.
Available to work on-site in India.

roles.title: Composite Manufacturing
roles.summary: Carbon-fibre tooling, layup, infusion, and assembly of airframe parts.
do: Lay up and infuse carbon-fibre parts for the airframe.
Make and maintain moulds and shop tooling.
Trim, fit, and assemble composite parts.
Inspect parts and keep a repeatable manufacturing process.
Work from CAD and drawings with the design team.
lookingFor: Hands-on composite manufacturing: wet layup, vacuum infusion, or similar.
Experience with moulds, trimming, or structural assembly.
Available to work on-site in India.
